text: よかった　みんな　げんきに　なりましたわ

structure.jp: みんな　げんきに　なりましたわ

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: げんきに　なりました
patterns.explanation: A describing word plus に and なる means to become that way. げんきに　なりました = 'became healthy'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a statement is a soft, ladylike touch with no meaning of its own. なりましたわ = 'they have become so'.
